X-Hot Green.description: X-Hot Green jerky is our hottest green chile carne seca, made in small batches in Albuquerque, NM. Heat 5 of 5. Small bag $7, large bag $20, door drop off.
about: This is the one the fiends ask for by name. X-Hot Green takes our classic New Mexico green chile carne seca and stacks even more green chile on top, so the heat builds with every strip and sticks around.

It's thin cut beef, seasoned heavy and dried slow by our family in Albuquerque. Expect that earthy, roasted green chile flavor first, then a burn that doesn't quit. If you grew up putting green on everything, this is your bag.
X-Hot Green.who: Green chile lovers and heat chasers. If you're new to our heat scale, start with Green (3) and work your way up.
reads: Green chile jerky ranked by heat

Mango Habanero.description: Mango Habanero jerky from Albuquerque: sweet mango up front, slow habanero burn on the way out. Small batch carne seca, heat 4 of 5. Bags $7 and $20.
about: Mango Habanero is the sweet heat of the menu. The first thing you taste is mango, bright and a little sticky, and then the habanero sneaks in and keeps building after you've finished the strip.

Like every bag we make, it starts with thin cut beef that our family seasons and dries in small batches in Albuquerque. It's a good pick for folks who want real heat but like something sweet riding along with it.
Mango Habanero.who: Anyone who likes sweet and spicy together. Hot, but friendlier than the X-Hot flavors.

Takis.description: Takis jerky from Jerky Fixx in Albuquerque: rolled chile lime crunch flavor on thin cut carne seca. Sour, spicy, heat 4 of 5. Small $7, large $20.
about: If you know the rolled chile lime snack, you already know what this tastes like. Our Takis flavor brings that sour, spicy, lime heavy punch to thin cut carne seca, and it disappears fast.
Our family seasons and dries every batch in Albuquerque. The thin cut is the secret here: it soaks up the chile lime seasoning so every bite is loud. Fair warning, people tend to buy two.
Takis.who: Chile lime fans and snack aisle kids at heart who want real heat.
reads: Hot Cheeto jerky and our snack flavors

Hot Cheetos.description: Hot Cheeto flavored jerky from Jerky Fixx in Albuquerque. Red hot cheeto dust packed into every strip of small batch carne seca. Heat 4 of 5, from $7.
about: This is the flavor that gets the most double takes at the booth. We pack red hot cheeto dust into every strip of thin cut carne seca, so you get that crunchy, cheesy, red hot flavor on real beef jerky.
It's made in small batches by our family in Albuquerque. Your fingers will be red and you won't care. Grab a large bag if you're sharing, because it won't last.
Hot Cheetos.who: Anyone who loves red hot snacks. Hot, but not as brutal as the X-Hot flavors.
reads: Best jerky flavors for game day

Hot Cheeto Pickle.description: Hot Cheeto Pickle jerky: dill pickle tang meets hot cheeto heat on small batch carne seca made in Albuquerque, NM. Heat 3 of 5. Bags $7 and $20.
about: It sounds wild. It sells out anyway. Hot Cheeto Pickle puts dill pickle tang and red hot cheeto heat on the same strip of thin cut carne seca, and somehow it just works.

Every batch is seasoned and dried by our family in Albuquerque. The pickle keeps it bright and sour, the cheeto dust brings the heat, and the beef holds it all together. It's the flavor people dare their friends to try, then buy for themselves.
Hot Cheeto Pickle.who: Pickle people, Hot Cheeto fans and anyone who likes a little weird.
reads: Hot Cheeto jerky and our snack flavors

Lemon Pepper.description: Lemon Pepper jerky from Jerky Fixx in Albuquerque: bright lemon and cracked black pepper on small batch beef jerky. Mild, heat 1 of 5. Bags $7 and $20.
about: Lemon Pepper is the classic that never gets old. Bright lemon, cracked black pepper and real beef, with just a whisper of heat.
Our family cuts, seasons and dries every batch in Albuquerque, and this is one of the flavors we never run out of fans for. It's easy to share and a safe bet when you're buying for a group.
Lemon Pepper.who: Anyone who wants big flavor with almost no heat. Great for road trips and game days.
reads: Best jerky flavors for game day

Garlic Parm.description: Garlic Parm jerky from Jerky Fixx: roasted garlic and nutty parmesan on small batch beef jerky made in Albuquerque. No heat, all flavor. Bags $7 and $20.
about: Mellow on the heat, loud on the flavor. Garlic Parm brings roasted garlic and nutty parmesan to thin cut beef, with no burn at all.
It's made in small batches by our family in Albuquerque, and it's a favorite with people who say they don't like spicy food. Heads up, it contains dairy.
Garlic Parm.who: No heat fans, garlic lovers and anyone building a mixed bag for a crowd.

Honey Teriyaki.description: Honey Teriyaki jerky from Jerky Fixx in Albuquerque: sweet, sticky and savory small batch beef jerky with no heat. The gateway flavor. Bags $7 and $20.
about: Sweet, sticky and savory. Honey Teriyaki is the gateway flavor, the one we hand to kids and grandmas, and the one heat chasers secretly grab between hot bags.
Every batch is seasoned and dried by our family in Albuquerque. Want a little kick? Try Honey Teriyaki Green, which adds a green chile bite on the finish.
Honey Teriyaki.who: Kids, grandmas and anyone who likes sweet and savory with zero heat.
